question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the morning rush window (08:00-10:00) versus the evening rush window (17:00-19:00) at Gate_MainEntrance for total person flow (person_entry + person_exit). Which window was busier and approximately by how much?
answer_text: On 2025-12-08 at Gate_MainEntrance the 08:00–10:00 window had 1,191 total persons versus 997 in 17:00–19:00; the morning was busier by 194 people, about 16.3% higher.

retrieved_communities.summary: Across the 17:00 UTC hour (events from 2025-12-01T17:00:17Z to 2025-12-01T17:59:36Z) on Platform_1, 194 events were recorded. Events were dominated by pedestrian movements: 92 person_entry and 89 person_exit (181 total), versus 5 car_entry and 8 car_exit. Average head count (mean-of-means) was 5.04 with a peak head_count of 13.0; peak event count for the hour was 194.

Cameras CAM_01 covered Gate_MainEntrance and Platform_1 from 2025-12-01T01:00:00Z to 2025-12-08T12:00:00Z (events recorded between 2025-12-01T01:04:10Z and 2025-12-08T12:59:57Z). Total volume was 1,775 events: person activity dominated (788 person_entry and 773 person_exit = 1,561 person events) versus 112 car_entry and 102 car_exit. Average head count (mean-of-means) was 10.42 with a peak head count of 47.0; node_count is 1,802 and average events/hour ≈ 9.9 (1775 events over ~179 hours); peak per-hour event count is not specified in the provided profile.

All events were recorded by CAM_02 at Gate_ParkingLot, covering activity from 2025-12-08T07:00:01Z to 2025-12-08T18:59:57Z with hourly aggregation reported for 07:00–17:00 UTC. Total volume was 1,529 events (node_count 1,532); person events dominated with 463 person_entry and 466 person_exit (929 total) versus 283 car_entry and 317 car_exit (600 total). Peak head_count is not available (null), and a peak events-per-hour value is not provided.

All activity was recorded on Platform_1 between 2025-12-01T02:00:27Z and 2025-12-01T02:55:55Z (hour window 2025-12-01T02:00:00Z UTC). Events were dominated by people movements (16 person_entry, 14 person_exit = 30 person events) with fewer vehicle movements (4 car_entry, 3 car_exit = 7 car events); total events = 37 and peak events per hour = 37. Peak head_count was 13, average head_count (mean of means) 5.05, node_count 39.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE c.camera_location = 'Gate_MainEntrance'
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T08:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS morning_count
}
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE c.camera_location = 'Gate_MainEntrance'
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T17:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T19:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS evening_count
}
RETURN morning_count,
       evening_count,
       CASE WHEN evening_count >= morning_count THEN evening_count - morning_count ELSE morning_count - evening_count END AS abs_diff,
       CASE
         WHEN morning_count = 0 AND evening_count = 0 THEN 0
         WHEN morning_count >= evening_count THEN round((toFloat(morning_count - evening_count) / morning_count) * 100 * 10) / 10
         ELSE round((toFloat(evening_count - morning_count) / evening_count) * 100 * 10) / 10
       END AS pct_of_busier,
       CASE WHEN morning_count > evening_count THEN 'morning' WHEN evening_count > morning_count THEN 'evening' ELSE 'equal' END AS busier_window
